ZaryaParticleGrenadeDemolitionsExpertQue.name: Demolitions Expert
ZaryaParticleGrenadeDemolitionsExpertQue.description: Quest: For every 5 enemy Heroes hit by Particle Grenade, its recharge rate lowers by 0.4375 seconds, up to 3.5 seconds. Reward: Once Particle Grenade has hit 40 enemy Heroes, its radius is increased by 15%.

ZaryaShieldAllyTogetherWeAreStrong.name: Together We Are Strong
ZaryaShieldAllyTogetherWeAreStrong.description: For 3 seconds after gaining Shield Ally, every 5.35 (+4% per level) damage done by the bearer contributes 1 Energy to Zarya, up to 40 Energy per Shield.

ZaryaWeaponFeelTheHeat.name: Feel the Heat
ZaryaWeaponFeelTheHeat.description: Zarya's Basic Attack deals 50% additional damage to enemies in melee range. While above 40 Energy, Zarya's Basic Attack size is increased by 35%.

ZaryaEnergyMaximumChargeQuest.name: Maximum Charge
ZaryaEnergyMaximumChargeQuest.description: Regen Globes now instantly grant 20 Energy. Quest: Spend 150 seconds at or above 50 Energy. Reward: Gain an additional 20 maximum Energy.

ZaryaPersonalBarrierIAmTheStrongest.name: I Am the Strongest
ZaryaPersonalBarrierIAmTheStrongest.description: Personal Barrier absorbs an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage. Passive: Damage absorbed by Zarya's Shields contributes 20% more Energy.

ZaryaShieldAllyGiveMeTwentyQuest.name: Give Me Twenty
ZaryaShieldAllyGiveMeTwentyQuest.description: Quest: Regeneration Globes increase Shield Ally absorb amount by 15, up to 300 permanently. Reward: After collecting 20 Regen Globes, permanently reduce the cooldown of Shield Ally by 2 seconds.

ZaryaShieldAllySpeedBarrier.name: Speed Barrier
ZaryaShieldAllySpeedBarrier.description: Shield Ally increases the allied Hero's Movement Speed by 50% for the duration.

ZaryaDefensiveShielding.name: Defensive Shielding
ZaryaDefensiveShielding.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier and Shield Ally grant 75 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks for 6 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

ZaryaParticleGrenadePinpointAccuracy.name: Pinpoint Accuracy
ZaryaParticleGrenadePinpointAccuracy.description: Particle Grenade deals 30 (+4% per level) more damage and Slows Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds to enemies hit by the center of the blast.

ZaryaDeepBurn.name: Deep Burn
ZaryaDeepBurn.description: Hitting a Hero with Particle Grenade causes Basic Attacks against them to generate 2 Energy. Lasts 3 seconds.

ZaryaPersonalBarrierExplosiveBarrier.name: Explosive Barrier
ZaryaPersonalBarrierExplosiveBarrier.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier explodes, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

ZaryaHeroicAbilityGravitonSurge.name: Graviton Surge
ZaryaHeroicAbilityGravitonSurge.description: Launch a gravity bomb that detonates after 1 second and draws enemy Heroes toward the center for 2.5 seconds. Affected Heroes take 30 (+4% per level) damage a second.

ZaryaHeroicAbilityExpulsionZone.name: Expulsion Zone
ZaryaHeroicAbilityExpulsionZone.description: Launch a gravity bomb that deals 124 (+4% per level) damage and creates an expulsion zone for 3.5 seconds. Enemies who enter the affected area are knocked back and have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 1 second.

ZaryaPersonalBarrierUnstoppableCompetito.name: Unstoppable Competitor
ZaryaPersonalBarrierUnstoppableCompetito.description: Personal Barrier makes Zarya Unstoppable for up to 2 seconds.

ZaryaPersonalBarrierSpellBarrier.name: Spell Barrier
ZaryaPersonalBarrierSpellBarrier.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier grants Zarya 75 Spell Armor for 3 Seconds, reducing the damage taken from Abilities by 75%.

ZaryaEnergyEnduranceTraining.name: Endurance Training
ZaryaEnergyEnduranceTraining.description: While at or above 75 Energy, Zarya gains 20 Armor, reducing all damage taken by 20%.

ZaryaPainIsTemporary.name: Pain is Temporary
ZaryaPainIsTemporary.description: Activate to consume all Energy and gain a Shield that absorbs 0.5% of Zarya's maximum Health per Energy consumed and lasts for 3 seconds. Zarya may only have one personal Shield active on herself at a time.

ZaryaShieldAllyCleansingShield.name: Cleansing Shield
ZaryaShieldAllyCleansingShield.description: Causes Shield Ally to remove all disabling effects and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

ZaryaShieldAllyGainTrain.name: Gain Train
ZaryaShieldAllyGainTrain.description: Shield Ally now grants an untalented Shield to a nearby ally upon impact.

ZaryaEnergyBornInBattle.name: Born in Battle
ZaryaEnergyBornInBattle.description: While at or above 75 Energy, Zarya's cooldowns regenerate 25% faster.

ZaryaGravitonSurgeGravityKills.name: Gravity Kills
ZaryaGravitonSurgeGravityKills.description: Increases Graviton Surge's duration by 1 second and it Silences Heroes caught in its area.

ZaryaExpulsionZoneClearOut.name: Clear Out
ZaryaExpulsionZoneClearOut.description: Reduce Expulsion Zone's cooldown by 25 seconds and increase its duration by 1.5 seconds.

ZaryaParticleGrenadeGrenadier.name: Grenadier
ZaryaParticleGrenadeGrenadier.description: All Particle Grenade charges are returned at once.

ZaryaUnyieldingDefender.name: Unyielding Defender
ZaryaUnyieldingDefender.description: Activate to reset the cooldown of Personal Barrier and Shield Ally.
